primary_concerns: Performance optimization needed for 60 FPS target
Memory management issues in audio system

key_strengths: Comprehensive feature set (5 major features completed)

critical_findings.details: Excessive haptic feedback on every tap causes UI lag, battery drain, and potential frame drops
critical_findings.recommendation: Use HapticFeedbackConstants with debouncing, add user controls

critical_findings.details: Full game state updates every 100ms trigger unnecessary UI recompositions across all screens
critical_findings.recommendation: Implement derivedStateOf and selective state updates

critical_findings.details: Full JSON snapshot via JNI every 100ms creates significant performance bottleneck
critical_findings.recommendation: Implement delta updates, selective queries, consider Protocol Buffers

critical_findings.details: Media3 ExoPlayer and SoundPool may not release resources properly
critical_findings.recommendation: Use DisposableEffect, implement proper lifecycle management

high_priority_findings.impact: Excludes visually impaired users, fails WCAG compliance
high_priority_findings.recommendation: Add semantics modifiers, content descriptions, TalkBack support

high_priority_findings.impact: Poor perceived performance, user confusion during initialization
Poor tablet experience, issues with foldables
high_priority_findings.recommendation: Use BoxWithConstraints, WindowSizeClass for adaptive layouts

high_priority_findings.impact: May not achieve 60 FPS on low-end devices

high_priority_findings.recommendation: Convert to LazyColumn with proper keys

positive_aspects: Thread-safe C++ simulation with mutex protection
Character and family systems fully functional
architecture_concerns: Auto-save timing could conflict with animations

short_term: Implement loading states and skeleton screens

testing_priorities: Performance testing on 3+ device types (low/mid/high end)
Long play session stress testing (1+ hour)

estimated_impact_of_fixes.performance: 30-50% improvement in frame times, consistent 60 FPS on mid-range devices
estimated_impact_of_fixes.user_experience: 20-30% lower bounce rate, better perceived performance

high_risk: Crashes on low-end devices due to memory issues
